summary: Fixed RedisCache.get_or_compute to treat a miss as 'raw key is None' instead of a falsy deserialized value, so 0/''/[] (and a cached JSON null) are served from cache. Ran pytest: 7 passed, 2 skipped — both Redis tests (including the falsy-value regression test) skipped because no Redis server is reachable on localhost:6379, so the change is NOT verified by the test suite. An ad-hoc script with an in-memory fake Redis client confirmed compute runs once for 0, '', [], None and a dict. localhost listed only because the test conftest attempted a Redis ping (connection refused).
